info.name: Stedi Healthcare Claims Claim acknowledgments Transactions API

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of elements to return in a page. You can set this to a maximum of 500 elements. If not specified, the default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A token returned by a previous call to this operation in the `nextPageToken`. If not specified, Stedi returns the first page of results.

params.name: businessIdentifier
params.description: List only transactions containing a business identifier with the given value.

params.name: transactionSetId
params.description: List only a given type of transaction. Accepts any valid 3-digit X12 Transaction Set Identifier Code, as defined in the X12 standard. See: <https://www.stedi.com/edi/x12/element/143>.

params.name: sender
params.description: List only transactions sent by the given profile. This is the profile ID of the sender.

params.name: receiver
params.description: List only transactions sent to the given profile. This is the profile ID of the receiver.

params.name: direction
params.description: The direction of the transaction. Inbound transactions are those you receive from a payer, provider, or other trading partner. Outbound transactions are those you send to a payer, provider, or other trading partner.

params.name: mode
params.description: Indicates whether the transaction contains test or production data. Stedi determines this from the value in [`ISA15` Usage Indicator Code](https://www.stedi.com/edi/x12/segment/ISA#ISA-15).

params.name: status
params.description: A status indicating whether Stedi was able to successfully process the transaction.

params.name: from
params.description: The start of the time range to filter transactions. The results will include transactions created at or after this timestamp.

params.name: to
params.description: The end of the time range to filter transactions. The results will include transactions up to and including this timestamp.

params.name: elementId
params.description: List only transactions containing a business identifier with the given element ID. This is the X12 element ID, such as "127" for Reference Identification. May only be supplied if `businessIdentifier` is also supplied. See Stedi's EDI references pages to find element IDs.

params.name: partnershipId
params.description: List only transactions that were sent or received on the given partnership. This is the partnership ID, such as "local_clearinghouse-test".

This endpoint is used to retrieve a transaction fragment's output document URL after it has been translated via Core.

This endpoint returns the document download URL, it must be then fetched for the actual document content.
There are no size restrictions on documents when fetching from this endpoint, however they are generally smaller and consumable by nature of being a fragment.
